scope: One sequential local run per version, same pre-effect conflict window at 30–35s, 60s arrivals at 16/s, four projects, 100ms synthetic provider, default 300s lease, up to 360s drain. No provider network. Parent imported from PR23 worktree (same runtime source as merged base). Natural contention varies; not a throughput multiplier or statistical capacity study. Individual starts aggregated; counts, percentiles, maximum wait, one-second observations and durable outcomes retained. A separate small race test ran in an isolated database during the parent lease wait; no dedicated-machine isolation claimed.
